name: interview-prep
//: build:deps builds every workspace that another workspace compiles
against, in dependency order. It is a prerequisite for `test` and for any
service's `bundle`: @ip/* imports resolve through the workspace symlink to
dist/index.d.ts, so a consumer cannot compile before its producers have
emitted declarations. billing and chat are listed because chat imports
sanctioned P1 couplings. When P4 and P5 remove them, drop the two service
builds and keep the three packages.

scripts.build:deps: npm run build --workspace @ip/auth --workspace @ip/config --workspace @ip/dynamo && npm run build --workspace @ip/billing-service && npm run build --workspace @ip/chat-service
